rules: Modules and AI routes never receive raw provider credentials.
Credential/key material is held only by the platform broker or an explicitly qualified host boundary.
Browser storage protection is not represented as encryption or device security without exact mechanism evidence.
Passkey/device-unlock convenience cannot be the only recovery authority.
Origin, profile, device loss, logout, revocation, rotation, export, and restore are explicit lifecycle cases.
Credential failure degrades the affected optional route without stranding local canonical data or Recovery.
No unofficial provider bridge or hidden backend is admitted.
Every v0.18 credential claim requires current target, permission, revocation, recovery, and human evidence.
